# 获取识别距离
##### 简要描述

- URI中的ChannelID表示通道编号，对于IPC来说，ChannelID固定为1

**XML**字段解释<span lang="EN-US"></span>

| 字段 | 类型 | 描述 | 是否必须 |
| --- | --- | --- | ---- |
| ChannelID | integer | 通道号，对于IPC来说，ChannelID固定为1<span lang="EN-US"></span> | 否<span lang="EN-US"></span> |
| Distance | integer | 识别距离，单位:厘米<span lang="EN-US"></span> | 否<span lang="EN-US"></span> |

![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

``` http
GET /FaceRecognition/1/RecoDistance HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.42.0
Accept: */*
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: 97e498c7-2cef-4820-b94f-3be673bbe260
Host: 192.168.6.150
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive


HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.5
Content-Length:151
Content-Type:application/xml
Connection:close

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<FaceRecoDistance Version="1.0">
<ChannelID>1</ChannelID>
<Distance>100</Distance>
</FaceRecoDistance>
```

GET HTTP请求示例
GET /FaceRecognition/1/RecoDistance HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
Content-Type: application/xml
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.26.10
Accept: _/_
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: d7e5cf04-2a97-4b87-801a-38bfcc240c0a
Host: 192.168.1.100
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive

GET HTTP响应示例
HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.0
Content-Type: application/xml
Connection: close
Content-Length: 124

\<FaceRecoDistance>
\<ChannelID>1\</ChannelID>
\<Distance>1500\</Distance>
\</FaceRecoDistance>

##### 请求URL

 - `/FaceRecognition/ChannelID/RecoDistance` 

##### 请求方式

- get
 
##### 成功返回示例  
```
[]

```
